package day5;

public class Program_SeparatePosNeg {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
int[]arr= {-4, 7, 0, -2, 9, 0, -8, 5};
int num=0;
for (int i=0; i<arr.length; i++)
{
	num=arr[i];
	if (num>0)
	{
System.out.print(num+" ");	
	}
}
for (int i=0; i<arr.length; i++)
{
	num=arr[i];
	if (num<0)
	{
System.out.print(num+" ");	
	}
}
for (int i=0; i<arr.length; i++)
{
	num=arr[i];
	if (num==0)
	{
System.out.print(num+" ");	
	}
}

	}

}
